<explanation>
Based on the provided file tree and README, I'll explain how to create a comprehensive system design diagram for Neurite, which is a complex web-based application that combines fractal visualization with AI-powered knowledge management.

1. Main System Components

The system architecture should be divided into these major components:

a) Frontend Layer:
- Fractal Visualization Engine (js/mandelbrot/)
- Node Management System (js/nodes/)
- User Interface Components (js/interface/)
- AI Integration Layer (js/ai/)
- Zettelkasten System (js/zettelkasten/)

b) Backend Services (localhost_servers/):
- AI Proxy Server
- Automation Server
- Direct Access Server
- Web Scraping Service
- Wikipedia Search Service
- Wolfram Alpha Integration

2. Component Relationships

Draw the following connections:

```
[Frontend Layer] ←→ [Backend Services]
     ↑↓               ↑↓
[Local Storage] ←→ [Vector Database]
     ↑↓
[AI Systems] ←→ [External APIs]
```

3. Detailed Component Breakdown

Frontend Components:
```
Fractal Engine
├── Mandelbrot Renderer
├── Fractal Navigation
└── Update System

Node System
├── Node Types
│   ├── AI Nodes
│   ├── Text Nodes
│   ├── Media Nodes
│   └── Link Nodes
├── Node Interaction
└── Node Utilities

Interface Layer
├── Custom UI Components
├── Dropdown System
├── Search API
└── Function Calling Panel

AI Integration
├── Multiple AI Providers
├── Vision System
├── Network Handler
└── Prompt Management

Zettelkasten
├── Code Mirror Integration
├── Path Management
└── Syntax Handler
```

4. Data Flow Visualization

Show data flow with directional arrows:
```
User Input → Interface Layer → Node System → Fractal Engine
    ↑↓           ↑↓              ↑↓             ↑↓
AI System ←→ Backend Services ←→ External APIs   
```

5. Key Technical Elements to Highlight

- Real-time Fractal Rendering System
- Physics-based Node Graph System
- Multi-Agent AI Communication Network
- Vector Database Integration
- Bi-directional Sync System
- Custom API Integration Layer

6. Color Coding Scheme

Use distinct colors for:
- Blue: Core Fractal Components
- Green: Node Management System
- Purple: AI Integration
- Orange: Backend Services
- Yellow: External APIs
- Gray: Utility Functions

7. Implementation Details

The diagram should emphasize:
- Modular Architecture: Show clear separation between components
- Event System: Illustrate how components communicate
- State Management: Display data flow between components
- External Integration: Show connections to third-party services
- Scalability Points: Highlight areas designed for extension

8. Special Considerations

Include visual indicators for:
- Real-time Processing Components
- AI Communication Paths
- Data Persistence Methods
- User Interaction Flows
- System Extension Points

This system design should be created using a professional diagramming tool that supports:
- Nested components
- Bidirectional relationships
- Color coding
- Clear typography
- Proper spacing and alignment

The final diagram should maintain a balance between showing the complexity of the system while remaining clear and understandable at a glance.

</explanation>
